summary: Phase 1 of Aftersales Contract Automation Engine tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass. Frontend: CRM Corporate mode shows a single 'Aftersales Contracts' tab (no standalone 'Contracts' tab); all 5 sub-tabs render (Dashboard, Contracts & Renewals, Pricing & Rules, Equipment Review, Supportability). Dashboard shows £165,000 ACV / 1 active contract / 453 supportability reviews / 1 wording conflict. Deterministic engine verified from UI: Gold 200H · Console 6 (Series 3) x2 = £688.74 final / £57.40 monthly / £137.75 VAT — matches spreadsheet exactly. Platinum + 10% discount surfaces REVIEW REQUIRED with 'Manual RRP required' and 'Service Manager approval' reasons. Contracts & Renewals sub-tab embeds the existing CRMContracts workspace correctly (£165,000 active contract listed). Supportability evaluate for 200C returns Manual Review; decision memory record + list + delete work. Fixed a real backend defect (record_audit signature mismatch) that was 500'ing 3 PUT/POST endpoints.
action_items: No functional action items — feature works as specified. Main agent may wish to review the 5 record_audit(...) call-sites in /app/backend/routes/crm_aftersales.py that were converted from positional to keyword-only args to match utils/crm_audit.record_audit() signature.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED BY TESTER: All 5 record_audit(...) calls in routes/crm_aftersales.py used positional args, but utils/crm_audit.record_audit() is keyword-only (defined with `*`). This caused 500s on PUT /rate-groups/{id}, PUT /contract-types/{id}, PUT /packages/{id}, PUT /service-configs/{id}, POST /supportability/decisions. Converted all call-sites to keyword form (entity_type=, entity_id=, action=, user=, before=, after=, summary=, extra=). Also normalised action verbs to 'update'/'create' so change diffs are generated.
routes/crm_aftersales.py is 777 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting into aftersales_pricing.py, aftersales_supportability.py, aftersales_dashboard.py.

Rate-group PUT + contract-type PUT auto-derive one of adjustment_pct/pricing_factor from the other, but small floating-point drift (0.1 vs 0.09999…) means naive equality checks in the FE could show 'dirty' state. Consider rounding on write.

rca_of_the_issue: record_audit() in utils/crm_audit.py is declared with `*` making all args keyword-only. All 5 call-sites in crm_aftersales.py passed positional args → TypeError → 500. The exception was NOT caught (record_audit's own try/except is inside the function body, but the signature check happens before). Fix: convert all call-sites to keyword form. Reproduction (pre-fix): `curl -X PUT $API/crm/v2/aftersales/rate-groups/{id} -d '{"standard_pct":0.101}' -H 'Auth: Bearer $CRM_TOKEN'` → 500 with backend log 'record_audit() takes 0 positional arguments but 6 were given'.
